2010.simple: A small computer in your pocket, with radios for Wi-Fi and 3G. Its screen is small, so small videos look fine on it.
2010.technical: A 2010 smartphone (an iPhone 4 or an Android of the day): HSDPA category 8–10 and HSUPA. An endpoint: it opens (and checks) every layer, from the 3G frame up to HTTP.
